findings.title: Config path can still break the one-line error
findings.description: `loadConfig` runs only the error detail through `oneLine()` and interpolates `JSON.stringify(configPath)` without escaping DEL, C1 controls, or U+2028/U+2029. When a supplied `--config` path contains those characters, both read-error and parse-error diagnostics can carry them raw to stderr, where Unicode-aware viewers may display an apparent extra line.

findings.title: Backlog marks T-008 done before it is merged
findings.description: The BACKLOG row sets T-008 to `done (issue #20)` while the journal's PR link is still `_TODO after the human commits_`. Every other finished row cites the merged PR, not the issue. After merge, the tracker points to no PR and claims done for work that was not committed when the row was written.
